label: Codex approval review: bulk snapshot run and receipt-pinned rollback helper for disposable Windows VM DB
summary: Reviewed and approved a sequence of Codex tool-call actions on the HMS disposable Windows VM: running the already-authorized guarded bulk snapshot-create-and-verify script over the existing SSH connection; creating a receipt-pinned rollback helper script whose destructive --revert path requires an explicit confirmation flag and defaults to read-only Check mode; and adding post-transfer SHA-256 integrity verification to that helper. All actions approved as low/medium risk since none modified source data, exported credentials, or executed an actual rollback.
